5d5232e3cb.q: What is the number one challenge law firms face when working with marketing agencies?
5d5232e3cb.a: The number one challenge is how lawyers operate based on referrals. Even when an agency does great work, lawyers take a very calculated approach to referring partners, often waiting six months to a year to see more results before making referrals, unlike HVAC business owners who immediately justify and promote their purchase to friends.

77706b942c.q: Why are law firms missing opportunities with leads they generate through marketing?
77706b942c.a: The biggest problem is not marketing on the web, but handling the leads that come in. Lawyers often fail to respond to contact forms, answer phones rudely, or don't call people back. Even if a lead isn't a perfect fit, they should still be taken care of; otherwise they will leave negative reviews, damaging the firm's reputation.

f39f27a209.q: Why should small law firms focus on their personal brand and local reputation instead of competing on broad keywords?
f39f27a209.a: Attorneys now need to lean into what's unique, with personal brands more important than ever. People still prefer to work with local attorneys, and big firms like Morgan & Morgan can market heavily but cannot build the local presence that a community-based lawyer can. Small firms should market their uniqueness and local reputation rather than trying to rank for vanity keywords.
